# Town of Thetford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 23; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Thetford, 'Elected and Appointed Officers' roster (updated September 22, 2026; town website): names Sarah Aspell as Town Moderator (the roster prints her one-year term as expiring in 2026 -- the same stale-line anomaly as the town clerk's line; the roster is the town's current post-election roster and presents her as the sitting moderator). She is also School Moderator, a school office not modeled here
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Town of Thetford, 'Elected and Appointed Officers' roster (updated September 22, 2026; town website): names Tracy Borst as Town Clerk, and the town's Town Clerk page identifies her as the sitting clerk. Both the roster and the annual report print her three-year term as expiring in 2026 even though the March 2026 election has passed -- the line appears stale; she is seated on the live clerk page and the Secretary of State concurrence
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Tracy Borst as Thetford's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Tracy Borst as Thetford's Town Clerk (June 2026, postdating the March 2026 town meeting)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Thetford, 'Elected and Appointed Officers' roster (updated September 22, 2026; town website): names Tracy Borst as Town Treasurer, term to 2028
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Tracy Borst as Thetford's Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Tracy Borst as Thetford's Town Treasurer

Town of Thetford, 'Elected and Appointed Officers' roster (updated September 22, 2026; town website): names Sharon Harkay (Chair, term to 2029), David Goodrich (Vice Chair, to 2028), David Forbes (to 2028), Li Shen (to 2027), and Steve Tofel (to 2027)

Town of Thetford, 2025 Annual Report (for the March 2026 town meeting), 'THETFORD ELECTED OFFICIALS' pages 1-2: the pre-election roster confirms the same five members, with Harkay's and Goodrich's seats standing in 2026

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names David Forbes, David Goodrich, Sharon Harkay (Chair), Li Shen, and Steven Tofel for Thetford's five-member board
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms

Town of Thetford, 'Elected and Appointed Officers' roster (updated September 22, 2026; town website): names Sean Boyce (term to 2027), Sue Howard (printed as expiring 2026 -- her seat stood at the March 2026 meeting and the updated September roster still presents her as a sitting lister), and Barbara Harrington (to 2028)

Town of Thetford, 'Elected and Appointed Officers' roster (updated September 22, 2026; town website): names Sam Eaton (term to 2027), Ruth MacKinnon (to 2028), Ellen Stone (to 2029), Richard Landry (to 2030), and Keith Waterman (to 2031) on five-year staggered terms

Town of Thetford, 2025 Annual Report (for the March 2026 town meeting), 'THETFORD ELECTED OFFICIALS' pages 1-2: the pre-election roster shows Landry's, Stone's, and Waterman's seats expiring in 2026; the September roster's new expiries reflect their March 2026 re-elections
